title: Tumor-hepatocyte crosstalk drives a hepatic lactate-TGF-β axis of CD8T cell exhaustion and immunotherapy resistance in small-cell lung cancer liver metastases.
publicationName: bioRxiv : the preprint server for biology

snippet: Liver metastases confer poor outcomes and attenuate the benefit of immunotherapy across solid tumors. This study investigated how the hepatic metastatic niche promotes CD8⁺ T cell dysfunction and immunotherapy resistance in small-cell lung cancer (SCLC).
